prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 32-year-old clean-shaven father with short ginger hair and freckles sits securely in an armchair, holding his fully clothed newborn for the first time. One forearm supports the infant body and his other hand reliably cradles the head and neck. He looks down with quiet awe. Use bedroom window light, a plain sleepsuit and blanket, clear safe support and no medical equipment. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Vertical 4:5 cover composition. Keep faces and important hands above the lower fifth; normal continuous clothing or furniture forms the quiet lower area. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional composition and anatomy requirements: Exact 4:5 vertical photograph. Make the newborn's head and neck visibly supported together by the father's open palm, while his opposite forearm supports the complete torso and clothed legs in a secure cradle hold. Infant lies close against his body, relaxed and fully clothed in a plain closed sleepsuit; no dangling head or unsupported body. Show both adult hands with plausible separate fingers, only two adult arms, and an intact continuous lap below.
review: Reviewed full portrait: ginger-haired clean-shaven father cradles a fully clothed newborn close to his body. One open hand visibly cups the back of the baby's head and supports the neck, while the opposite forearm and hand support the torso and clothed legs. Both adult hands connect plausibly; the infant lies securely without a dangling head. Continuous lap and armchair below. PNG 1122x1402.
